basis: User identifies CI as their earlier draft method. No CI public publication was supplied for this revision.

MAPPO.adaptation: Shared decentralized continuous actors, centralized value, GAE/PPO and PopArt; measured current state, direct thrusters.
MAPPO.status: Training, restore, fixed validation selection and common final-evaluation entry implemented; new training results pending.
MAPPO.legacy_result_identity: train/train_mappo.py and historical mappo/VRX MAPPO outputs use PredictiveMAPPO.

MAAC.adaptation: Shared continuous actors, attention critic, entropy objective, target networks and replay; measured current state, direct thrusters.
MAAC.status: Training, replay/optimizer/RNG restore and common evaluation entry implemented; new training results pending.

CITF-Phys.execution: reference stopped-distance Controller(model=None); held-thrust nominal forecast and matched candidate initialization/search
CITF-Phys.reuse_formal_scores: only if complete runtime, data and effective protocol hashes match; archived CI-original never substituted

CI-original.runtime: unmodified legacy CI implementation; preserve original code/data/checkpoint identity

CITF-independent.definition: common-reference one-pass local selection with the same learned scorer

CITF-GRU.definition: matched GRU predictor in the reference stopped-distance control pipeline

CITF-Perceiver.definition: matched action-conditioned Perceiver predictor in the reference stopped-distance control pipeline

CITF-physical-feedback.definition: information-matched physical feedback model; distinguish from nominal held-thrust CITF-Phys
CITF-physical-feedback.source_learning: Shared source SAC may remain learned; physical describes the added feedback and scoring layer.
CITF-physical-feedback.comparison_purpose: Measure added interaction learning with matched source, control domain and resources.

retained-joint-policy-teacher.display_name: 保留的已学习联合策略教师
retained-joint-policy-teacher.learned_components: Source SAC and retained learned joint-configuration policy; identify checkpoints in each runtime.
retained-joint-policy-teacher.current_runtime_role: reference_mode selects online teacher, current source center, or direct control. Optional teacher rollout warmstart supervises force and return before independent PPO.
retained-joint-policy-teacher.current_action: clip(reference + residual_scale*tanh(latent), -500, 1000); direct reference is the fixed 250 N normalization midpoint.
retained-joint-policy-teacher.current_learning_target: Actual complete-episode terminal reward and time cost.
retained-joint-policy-teacher.comparison_purpose: Measure the incremental rescue, harm and net task change of the added module against its exact retained teacher.
retained-joint-policy-teacher.research_use: Reuse, replace, jointly optimize or remove according to task benefit and total cost.
retained-joint-policy-teacher.paper_accounting: Include actual teacher/encoder initialization data, learning and online cost. Attribute physical control and learned improvements to the retained mechanisms.
retained-joint-policy-teacher.role_selection: Use complete-task results and cost to retain, fine-tune, replace or remove teacher dependence.

benefit_reporting.complete_method: Compare the full deployed method with public algorithms on the common task.
benefit_reporting.added_module: Compare against the exact teacher/reference used by that method on the same tasks.
benefit_reporting.mechanism: Match shared components, control domain and reasonable resources for the mechanism being claimed.
benefit_reporting.protocol_change: Reevaluate methods and references under the same corrected environment; retain historical scores under their original protocol.

public_prior_status_rule: If a public CI paper/preprint/report is later supplied, audit overlap and update citations and contribution attribution before submission; do not conceal it.
registry_scope: Existing method identities and historical results retain these definitions; register revised controls for the selected research method. Current research authority is in AGENTS.md and CODEX_TASK.md.
